issues.t: CVT drive belt can wear out early
issues.sym: Shudder or hesitation when pulling away, a whining noise, a check engine light or flashing D light, and in the worst case the car losing drive.
issues.why: The steel belt inside the continuously variable automatic can deteriorate sooner than it should. Honda released a software update that watches the belt and extended the transmission warranty to 7 years or 150,000 miles for cars that had the update.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether the update in bulletin 21-046 was done and whether the car still qualifies under 21-047. If it shudders or loses drive, stop driving and have it inspected before the transmission fails.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine
issues.sym: The engine cranks but will not start, runs rough, or shuts off while driving, often with a check engine light.
issues.why: The impeller inside the in-tank fuel pump can absorb fuel, swell and jam against the pump body, so fuel stops reaching the engine. Honda recalled these pumps.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 20V314, 21V215 and 23V858 and have the pump replaced. An engine that stalls in traffic is a safety risk, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Rear brake caliper pistons can let air into the brakes
issues.sym: A brake pedal that feels soft or sinks further than normal, or longer stopping distances.
issues.why: Some rear brake caliper pistons were made with a faulty coating. Gas can form in the brake fluid, which makes the pedal soft and cuts braking power.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 18V777. If the pedal feels soft, have the brakes bled and inspected before driving any distance.

issues.t: Backup camera screen can go blank
issues.sym: The center screen stays black, freezes or shows no picture when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: A fault in the display audio unit can stop it from booting or showing the camera picture. Honda issued recalls to update or repair it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 23V046 and 24V384 and book the repair. Until then, use your mirrors and look behind you when backing up.

issues.t: Rear window can shatter when the defroster is on
issues.sym: A loud bang followed by the rear glass breaking into small pieces, usually in cold weather shortly after the rear defroster is switched on.
issues.why: Sealer used to bond the rear glass can touch the defroster grid lines. That creates a hot spot that weakens the glass until it breaks. Honda did not issue a safety recall but set up a product update to replace the glass.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer whether your VIN is in the rear glass product update and have the glass replaced. If it has already broken, cover the opening and get it replaced before driving in bad weather.

issues.t: Front seat belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet
issues.sym: There is usually nothing to notice beforehand. In a crash the front seat belt may not tighten and hold the occupant as designed.
issues.why: Some front seat belt pretensioners were assembled without a rivet that holds the mechanism together, so the belt may not restrain properly in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 23V782 and have the belts inspected as soon as you can. This is a crash-safety repair, so do not wait.

issues.t: Steering can feel sticky or hard to turn
issues.sym: The steering wheel feels notchy or stuck near center, needs extra effort to make small corrections on the highway, then seems to jump.
issues.why: A part inside the steering gearbox was made in a way that causes too much friction, so the steering can bind. Honda recalled these vehicles to rework the gearbox.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 24V744 and have it done. If the steering sticks, slow down, keep both hands on the wheel and get it to a dealer promptly.
